answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through optical physical unclonable functions. Each agent must probe a unique mineral token, such as microstructures in jade or onyx, with a laser to yield verifiable challenge-response speckle patterns. This forces an attacker to provision scarce physical matter and dedicated optical scanners per identity instead of cloning software nodes. However, thermal drift can shift speckle patterns to a reliability nadir, causing false rejections.
